# Ace Education

> Ace Education is an exam prep and study app for secondary school and university students in 15 countries: Nigeria, Ghana, Sierra Leone, The Gambia, Kenya, Zambia, United Kingdom, Canada, España, Ireland, South Africa, Uganda, Tanzania, Liberia, Malta. It offers topic notes, quizzes, a question bank, flashcards, timed mock exams, a weak-topic radar and an AI study buddy for 25 exams, written for each country's own exam body, subjects, currency and examples. Students can sign up free; schools and tutoring centres can ask for a plan.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/): what Ace Education is and who it is for
- [Countries and exams](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/countries): every country, exam, grading scale and question count
- [Features](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/features): everything in the student app
- [Syllabus explorer](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/syllabus): browse every subject, module and topic
- [For schools](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/schools): class, teacher and admin tools
- [Study guides](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/guides): revision, mock exams and wellbeing
- [Student app](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/app/): the study app itself

## Exam prep by country
- [Nigeria: WASSCE, UTME, NECO](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-nigeria): 63 subjects, 5,753 practice questions
- [Ghana: WASSCE, BECE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-ghana): 33 subjects, 2,877 practice questions
- [Sierra Leone: WASSCE, BECE, NPSE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-sierra-leone): 42 subjects, 3,267 practice questions
- [The Gambia: WASSCE, GABECE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-gambia): 35 subjects, 3,107 practice questions
- [Kenya: KCSE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-kenya): 15 subjects, 1,523 practice questions
- [Zambia: ECZ Grade 12](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-zambia): 15 subjects, 1,647 practice questions
- [United Kingdom: GCSE, A-Level](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-united-kingdom): 25 subjects, 2,708 practice questions
- [Canada: OSSD, Provincial diploma exams](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-canada): 21 subjects, 1,869 practice questions
- [España: EBAU / Selectividad](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-spain): 20 subjects, 1,475 practice questions
- [Ireland: Leaving Certificate](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-ireland): 18 subjects, 1,664 practice questions
- [South Africa: NSC](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-south-africa): 23 subjects, 2,140 practice questions
- [Uganda: UCE, UACE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-uganda): 28 subjects, 2,975 practice questions
- [Tanzania: CSEE, ACSEE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-tanzania): 28 subjects, 3,020 practice questions
- [Liberia: WASSCE](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-liberia): 9 subjects, 1,222 practice questions
- [Malta: SEC](https://abdullahmuhy-pixel.github.io/Ace/exam-prep-malta): 7 subjects, 803 practice questions
